/*ContactInfo.doQuery*/
SELECT USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC AS DEPT_NAME , ADDR.PHONE_NO1 AS CONTACT_NO , ADDR.PHONE_NO2 AS MOBILE_NO FROM SUSMT USMT JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON (USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.PLANT_CODE = DEPT.PLANT_CODE AND USMT.DEPT = DEPT.DEPT) JOIN SADDR ADDR ON (USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'USER') WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USMT.USER_ID = ${session.ID} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( DEPT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( ADDR.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N'
